# Storyteller, incidents and quests

`game.storyteller`, `game.incidents` and `game.quests` control the story the game tells: which storyteller runs, how hard it is, what happens, and which quests exist. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). `game.incidents.try_fire` and `list` (older) keep working next to the functions here.

`game.storyteller.difficulty()` returns every numeric and boolean difficulty setting by its field name, and `set_difficulty` changes one. Incidents take `points`, `faction` and `forced` options and run on the map you pass (the current map by default).

```lua
-- A custom storyteller: a raid every day sized to the colony
game.events.on("time.day_changed", function()
  local points = game.storyteller.threat_points()
  if game.incidents.can_fire("RaidEnemy", { points = points }) then
    game.raids.fire({ points = points })
  end
end)

-- Hand out a quest
local quest = game.quests.generate("OpportunitySite_ItemStash")
game.quests.accept(quest.id)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.storyteller.info` |  | `RimStorytellerInfo` | The storyteller, difficulty, threat points, wealth and colonists. |
| `game.storyteller.defs` |  | `RimStorytellerDef[]` | Every storyteller def. |
| `game.storyteller.set` | `def` | `string` | Switches the storyteller. Returns the def name. |
| `game.storyteller.threat_points` | `map?` | `number` | Threat points for a map, the current map by default. |
| `game.storyteller.difficulty` |  | `table<string, number` | boolean> \| Every numeric and boolean difficulty setting. |
| `game.storyteller.set_difficulty` | `name, value` | `string` | Changes one difficulty setting, for example threatScale. |
| `game.incidents.defs` |  | `RimIncidentDef[]` | Every incident def with category and chance. |
| `game.incidents.can_fire` | `def, opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Whether the game would let the incident fire now. |
| `game.incidents.fire` | `def, opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Fires an incident with options on a map (the current map by default). |
| `game.incidents.queue` | `def, ticks, opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Queues an incident to fire after some ticks. |
| `game.quests.list` | `state?` | `RimQuestInfo[]` | Every quest, optionally only those in one state. |
| `game.quests.defs` |  | `string[]` | Every quest script def name. |
| `game.quests.generate` | `root, points?` | `RimQuestInfo` | Generates a quest from a script and makes it available. |
| `game.quests.accept` | `id, pawn?` | `boolean` | Accepts a quest offer. |
| `game.quests.finish` | `id, outcome?` | `string` | Ends a quest with Success, Fail, InvalidPreAcceptance or Unknown. Returns the new state. |
| `game.quests.signal` | `tag` | `boolean` | Sends a quest signal that quest parts listen for. |
| `game.quests.slate_get` | `name` | `any` | A value of the quest slate while a Lua quest node runs, such as points, map, asker or any value an earlier node stored. nil when it is not set. |
| `game.quests.slate_set` | `name, value, kind?` | `boolean` | Stores a number, string or boolean in the quest slate for later nodes. kind forces int, float, string or bool, because slate values are typed. |
| `game.quests.slate_set_object` | `name, target` | `boolean` | Stores a game object (a pawn, thing, map or faction) in the quest slate. |
